notes: James H Harvey, 'WEBER COUNTY COMMISSONER' (the filer's own spelling on the form), 2016 cycle, signed by the candidate '31 OCTOBER 2016' and by committee secretary Judy M May 10/31/2016, and carrying the Weber County Clerk/Auditor's 'RECEIVED NOV 1 2016' stamp. EIGHT pages: cover p1, Form A running p2-p3-p4, Form B running p5-p6-p7-p8, page order matching form order. All six schedule sheets are ROTATED landscape (Amount along the TOP of the rendered page, Date along the bottom, rows advancing LEFT-TO-RIGHT) and all are typed. The largest filing in this chunk by row count: 60 contribution rows and 101 expenditure rows. ⚠ FOUR THINGS THE READER MUST RESPECT. (1) BOTH SCHEDULES ARE MULTI-SHEET CONTINUATIONS WITH NO PER-SHEET SUBTOTAL — only the last sheet of each prints a grand total (58,639.45 on p4, 56,420.94 on p8), so the reconciliation gate is the multi-sheet sum, and no single sheet's figure may be quoted as the schedule's. Only the FIRST sheet of each schedule carries the printed column headers and the gray spacer strip; the continuation sheets resume the grid with no header, which is why their first data band starts near the page edge. (2) THIS IS A WHOLE-CYCLE RESTATEMENT, NOT A PERIOD SLICE: the cover's Totals-from-Last-Report column is entirely BLANK and This Report == Cumulative on all three lines, and the schedules run from January 2016 to the day of filing. This is Harvey's officeholder-account behaviour in reverse — for 2016 he opened at zero. (3) THE FILER BOOKS IN-KIND ITEMS ON BOTH SIDES. Four contribution rows are labelled in-kind by the filer inside the donor-name cell (lines 2, 7, 9 and 40, totalling 3,716.96) and each has a matching Form B expenditure; a fifth pairing is the 10/31 'Pay Clerk' 500.00 that appears on both schedules. They are recorded as printed on both sides and NEVER netted — that is what each schedule's own total does, and netting would break both closes. (4) THE CANDIDATE IS ALSO THE LARGEST DONOR: four self-funding rows total 20,089.99, of which 7,000.00 is repaid on Form B as 'Loan Repay'. Smaller source properties, all preserved: three donor rows have no city that can be read honestly — line 38's address cell puts 'MSC' where a city belongs, line 41's contains only the words 'Weber County', and several rows print a city with no state — and in every case donor_city/donor_state are left BLANK or partial rather than inferred from the zip; neither schedule is in date order (Form A's second row is dated before its first; Form B lines 72-74 run 6/15, 6/22, 6/20); and several dates use the filer's two-digit-year form ('4/4/16', '5/3/16', '5/12/16', '4/18/16'), kept verbatim. ⚠ TWO CHANNELS, ONE FILING: this Wayback per-candidate PDF is the SAME 2016-10-31 report that also sits at pp14-21 of the 2016 consolidated archive PDF (cache 8876cae9); the stated cover totals were transcribed independently from both and match exactly. A cycle rollup must count this report ONCE. The candidate's street address and two phone numbers print in the clear on the cover — the predecessor host applied no redaction — and are deliberately not carried (PRIVACY.md); donor street addresses on Form A are likewise not carried, only city/state.
